Key.English: Removes ZEN's Create LZ, Create RP, Spawn Reinforcements, CAS, Atomic Bomb and Make Invincible modules, plus the vanilla Howitzer, Mortar and Rocket modules, from the Zeus Create menu entirely — all superseded by RTZ's own systems. Takes effect the next time the Zeus interface is opened.

The percentage of an object's cost refunded when a curator deletes it. Only objects a curator placed and that are still intact are refunded — corpses, wrecks and anything the mission itself placed are worth nothing.
Placing units, vehicles and static weapons costs curator points, shown as the resource bar in the Zeus interface. When disabled, everything is free. Costs refresh when the Zeus interface is reopened.

Show the size of the next income payout, and how long until it arrives, in the Zeus clock bar — in place of the mission countdown, which reads "--:--:--" on a mission with no time limit. Highlighted while your point bar is full, since a payout into a full bar is lost. A real mission countdown always takes the slot back.
How often income is paid out, in seconds. Lower values give smoother, more frequent payouts.
Show a Zeus feedback message with the point cost of the selected asset when choosing something to place.
Points a curator has on entering the Zeus interface for the first time, shown as the resource bar in the Zeus interface. 100 is a full bar.
